question: Rae's pantry held 57 jars of jam, and she made 48 more. She sold 96 jars at the market. She then cooked a new batch so that she had 7 jars for every jar left in the pantry. Her sister gave her 30 jars of jam. How many jars of jam did Rae have?

In the morning Sal had 21 bracelets in her craft box and made 24 more. She sold 29 bracelets at the morning market. In the afternoon she gave 9 bracelets to friends. In the evening she sold every remaining bracelet for 9 dollars each, then spent 59 dollars on beads. How many dollars did Sal have at the end of the evening?

A library has 2 branches, and each branch holds 77 DVDs. Each DVD runs for about 90 minutes. The library received 13 DVDs as a gift. It withdrew 94 damaged DVDs and lost 20 to overdue borrowers. It then bought 64 new DVDs. How many DVDs did the library have?

In the morning Tia's crew planted 67 seedlings in each of 7 rows in a field. In the afternoon they planted the same in each of 3 fields on the farm. In the evening the co-op recorded that each of its 7 farms had planted the same, and that the planting would be repeated on each of 9 days. How many seedlings would be planted in all?

A bookshop's display table held 55 cookbooks. The manager added 63 cookbooks from the stockroom and 60 from a new delivery. Customers bought 45 cookbooks on Saturday and 55 on Sunday. On Monday the manager added 69 more cookbooks. How many cookbooks were on the display table?
